description: This PHP class defines a CLI command for toggling the system check screen in the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base Command class and uses traits for configuration services. The command provides functionality to enable or disable the system check screen via command-line options.

classes.name: ToggleSystemCheckScreenCommand
classes.description: Defines a CLI command to toggle the system check screen feature in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the CLI command name used to invoke this command.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the command description and options.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the command to toggle the system check screen, toggling based on the 'status' option.
